record.body:
## Problem

`App.svelte` has 1,268 lines, and 613 are script. The UI has no component structure, and its pieces are hand-built.

## Approach

Move `dashboard/web/ui` to `dashboard/frontend`. Move polling, journal, and overlay state into `.svelte.ts` modules, and split the markup into Home, Journal, Overlay, and Side rail components (decision `app-split`). Initialize shadcn-svelte with a `$lib` alias and adopt its default theme (decisions `shadcn-svelte` and `shadcn-appearance`). Migrate tabs and dialogs first. Update the Vite config, tsconfig, server path, CI, and docs for the new folder. Task order: move the folder, set the alias and run the shadcn init, extract state modules, split the screens, migrate tabs and dialogs, verify.

## Exit criteria

Requirement ids come from the phase specification.

- R1, R2: The UI lives in `dashboard/frontend`, `dashboard/web` does not exist, and the server serves `dashboard/frontend/dist` (tests that check the tree and the `DIST` path).
- R3 to R5: `App.svelte` has fewer than 150 lines; polling, journal, and overlay state live in `.svelte.ts` modules under `src/lib/state`; Home, Journal, Overlay, and Side rail are components under `src/lib/screens` (tests).
- R6, R7, R9: `components.json` exists with `$lib` aliases, the alias resolves in `vite.config.ts` and the tsconfig, and the global CSS defines the shadcn theme variables (tests).
- R8: The phase and task overlay tabs and dialogs import shadcn-svelte components (test that greps).
- R10, R11: `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` pass in `dashboard/frontend`.
- R12: The existing `deepLinks` and `links` Vitest files pass unchanged (hash test and Vitest run).
- Integration: `dashboard/bin/web` serves the built UI from `dashboard/frontend/dist` (launch tests).

## Proof

kind: demo. A human looks at the running UI to confirm every screen renders in the new theme.

## Landing

Branch `phase/ui-structure`. Worktree `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/ui-structure`. Base `main`. Close by committing code on the phase branch, merging that branch into `main`, then committing the store on the primary checkout. Push is a human stop.

## Shape

Size: more than one sitting.
Human stops: none before the push at the end. The `App.svelte` line limit stays at the proposed 150 lines.
Collision: the open `shared-helpers` phase edits `dashboard/web/app.py` and `service.py` on unmerged branches; those files already moved to `dashboard/backend/server/` in earlier phases. This phase renames `dashboard/web/ui` to `dashboard/frontend`, which touches `ci.yml`, `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, and the node-ci and data-layer test paths. Tasks run serially. Biome excludes `src/lib/components/ui` (generated shadcn files) from lint and format.
